theme.description: High-end cinematic travel booking with raw data utility. Feels like a premium command center for European rail travel. 'Geo-map-first' UI where the dark-styled track map often serves as the canvas. A mix of midnight navy tones, strict technical grids, and vintage ticket typographic motifs.

rules.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black tracking-tighter uppercase

layout_and_spacing.general: Generous Spacing (p-8 to p-12). Asymmetric alignments for landing page.
layout_and_spacing.dashboard_grid: MODE B: 'Control Room' for search results. Tight gaps, high density. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4
layout_and_spacing.marketing_grid: MODE A: 'Tetris' Grid for landing hero. Hero Search Widget spans 8 cols, Image spans 4 cols.
layout_and_spacing.map_integration: Map sits fixed in background (h-screen, w-screen) under a pointer-events-none overlay. UI floats on top via pointer-events-auto.

surfaces_and_micro_themes.header_nav: Glassmorphism (Crystal/Apple variant). backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0c152b]/60 border-b border-white/10.
surfaces_and_micro_themes.search_widget: Solid background (#0c152b) with 'Tracing Beam' glowing border effect to make it pop against the map.
surfaces_and_micro_themes.ticket_cards: Grid Borders (Technical Look). Expose the skeleton. border-collapse layouts with border-b border-r border-[#1a2d5e]. No soft shadows. Sharp corners.
surfaces_and_micro_themes.delay_badges: Solid #E63946 background with sharp corners and IBM Plex Mono text.

components_strategy.search_inputs: Shadcn based. Heavily customized: flat, no radius (rounded-none), border-b only or sharp rectangles. Floating labels.
components_strategy.date_picker: Shadcn Calendar. Dark theme overrides, active dates highlighted in #E63946 or #FDFBF7.
components_strategy.map: Leaflet with react-leaflet. Use CartoDB Dark Matter tile layer or similar dark theme to match #0A0F1C background. OpenRailwayMap overlay for tracks.
components_strategy.cart_drawer: Shadcn Sheet component. Slid out from right. Minimalist, monochrome layout.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Text links and buttons get a sharp, immediate color fill. No slow muddy transitions.
motion_and_interactions.map_markers: Trains moving on the map should have a CSS radar pulse animation (ping) in #E63946.
motion_and_interactions.page_load: Framer Motion staggered fade-ups for timetable list items (y: 20, opacity: 0).

hero_background.description: Cinematic wide-angle view of a sleek high-speed train crossing an elegant minimalist bridge at twilight. Use for Landing Hero background or fallback.

map_abstract_bg.description: Abstract minimalist geometric background featuring intersecting railway tracks and map contour lines. Use as fallback texture behind UI where map is not active.

ticket_texture.description: Close-up macro shot of a vintage European train ticket. Use for decorative elements on the booking confirmation screen or empty states.

train_station_1.description: A Deutsche Bahn ICE train at a bustling Frankfurt train station at night. Use in 'About' or 'Stations' section header.

train_station_2.description: Impressive view of Antwerp's historic Central Station. Use for station detail headers or marketing blocks.

specific_page_instructions.landing: Map-first design. The hero background is a dark-styled Leaflet map OR the provided abstract railway map, heavily darkened. The search widget floats boldly in the center. Slogan 'Ein Ticket. Ganz Europa.' is in massive Cabinet Grotesk font.
specific_page_instructions.search_results: Asymmetric bento layout. Left column: Train results resembling stacked horizontal vintage tickets with dark theme styling. Right column: Live map showing the selected route.
specific_page_instructions.connection_detail: Control Room aesthetic. Detailed timeline of stations on the left with delay badges. The map dominates the right 2/3rds showing the real-time train icon on OpenRailwayMap tracks.
specific_page_instructions.cart_checkout: Swiss Brutalist logic. Ultra clean, high contrast. Cart items clearly broken down by leg. Stripe demo badge visible prominently. 'Sofortkauf' CTA button in #E63946.

technical_rules.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='search-trains-btn').
technical_rules.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react for high-end duotone or thin weights to match the vintage railway vibe.
